thread.title: This is how Apple’s stock traded around previous WWDCs

author: Emily Bary
title: This is how Apple’s stock traded around previous WWDCs
text:
Published: June 4, 2018 4:15 p.m. ET Share
A further 6.1% rally in the stock will make Apple the first trillion-dollar company Getty Images
By Emily Bary
Apple Inc.’s Worldwide Developer Conference is usually a dud for investors, the day of, the day after and for the next month, according to data provided by BTIG, but the technology giant’s stock broke with history as it rallied to a record close on Monday.
Don’t miss: If Apple makes big news at WWDC, that would be big news .
The stock AAPL, +0.84% rallied as much as 1.7% to a record intraday high earlier in the session, before paring gains to close up 0.8% at a record $191.83. It was a big surprise for the stock to close higher Monday, according to BTIG data, and it would be somewhat of a surprise if the stock also rose on Tuesday.
“Notably, Apple stock has never closed up on the actual first day of WWDC, but has closed down 1.2% on average,” Piecyk wrote in a note to clients, sent well before the keynote speech began. “Apple stock has also typically sold off the day after WWDC by a roughly similar amount.”
Meanwhile, the 4.4% gain in the past month is close to how it has performed ahead of past WWDCs.
